discriminant: A coordinate model is not definitionally a geometric label set.

localizers: IUT I section I1, printed p. 3
plain_statement: For prime l at least five, negation fixes exactly zero in Fl l.
discriminant: The historical theorem name mentions C05, but the canonical alias carries C01 only and no C05 coverage is transferred. The statement fails in characteristic two because 1=-1.

localizers: IUT I section I1, printed p. 3
plain_statement: The subgroup generated by -1 in the units of ZMod l has cardinality two.
discriminant: At characteristic two the signs coincide and the cardinality is one.

localizers: IUT I section I1, printed p. 3
plain_statement: The quotient of the units of Fl l by sign has (l-1)/2 elements.
discriminant: Zero is absent; adding it changes the l=5 count from two to three.

localizers: IUT I section I1, printed p. 3
plain_statement: A chart in the distinguished sign orbit descends to sign quotients; post-negation leaves the descended map unchanged; the additive quotient has (l+1)/2 classes; a closed countermodel rejects replacing the distinguished orbit by all equivariant charts.
discriminant: A multiplication-by-two chart over Fl 5 is sign-equivariant but outside the allowed orbit and induces a different quotient map.

localizers: IUT I section I1, printed p. 3

discriminant: At l=5, (1,true)*(2,false) has translation four, not the direct-product value three.

plain_statement: The T06 product acts by right-to-left affine composition: act (g*h) z = act g (act h z).
discriminant: At l=5 with g=(1,true), h=(2,false), z=3, both contracted sides are one; reversed composition gives a different value.

localizers: IUT I section I1, printed p. 3

localizers: IUT I section I1, printed p. 3
plain_statement: The positive-sign signed-affine maps form a normal subgroup of index two, with normality derived from the proved index.
discriminant: The visible reflection (0,true) is outside the subgroup and right multiplication by it toggles membership.

localizers: IUT I section I1, printed p. 3

discriminant: A negative pair (a,true) maps to sr(-a), not sr(a); at l=5 the two choices act on z=2 by four and two respectively.
